title: I Just Saw This Extremely Rare Photo Of Justin Bieber Before He Was Famous, And Holy F*ck, It's Totally Changing How I See Him
text:
I almost forgot who we were talking about.
I'm a Staff Writer for BuzzFeed, often covering topics like love and relationships; vintage and historical content; food; and anything else the internet is buzzing about.
Justin Bieberwith my sister on our laughably massive computer. And guess what? That song officially came out 17 years ago this summer. Yes, I feel old.along the way, many of us have forgotten how he started: As just a talented, innocent kid in small-town Ontario, skyrocketing to fame after being discovered singing covers on YouTube.
So recently, I came across this one super-rare photo of him before he was famous, and let me tell you, it absolutely shattered my worldview. Why? Because it reminded me how self-made and authentically talented he is. If this isn't a perfect time capsule of the year 2007, I don't know what is — or at least a sign of what was to come.
So excuse me for being sappy, but I guess you could say a picture really does speak a thousand words, because these photos from 2007 really did just single-handedly remind me of what I am at my core: a Belieber. What's your genuine opinion on Justin Bieber nowadays? And do you remember where you were when he was first discovered? Let's discuss in the comments below!
